verdict.rationale: Postmark is an email API service, and such a service could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only official SDK libraries, REST endpoints usable via curl, and an official MCP server. None of these is an official command-line tool: SDKs are developer building blocks, curl is a user-side workaround, and the MCP server belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
